programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio resulta herido al salvar a su hija en el atentado, y él y Chacorta logran escapar en una de las camionetas. Escobar le pide a Casillas sacar a su familia de Colombia, pero él no le cumple lo prometido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía captura a Casillas y lo sentencia a pagar por todo lo que ha hecho. Guadalupe le informa a Mónica que arrestaron a Aurelio; ella lo visita en prisión y le pide que se marchen juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Unos presos intentan asesinar a Aurelio, pero él se defiende. Explota una bomba en el carro en el que viajaban Ximena y sus hijos. Casillas sube a un helicóptero para su extradición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo le pregunta a Aurelio quién es Letrudo, y se une a los planes para vengarse con Chacorta y el Turco. Víctor llega al estudio de grabación para ver cómo va Matilde con el tema del disco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerrilla retiene a Aurelio y Socorro, y él le pide a Chacorta que lo rescate cuando las negociaciones se complican. El Tijera le dice a Guadalupe que Casillas recuperó la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Oscar obliga a Dobladillo a hablar por teléfono con Canica, quien le da la ubicación del comandante Macario, con quien debe de estar Aurelio. Mejía y Jiménez contactan a la agente Leonor Ballesteros.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le presenta a Mónica a la nueva piloto que contrató, pero ella la hace sentir incómoda. Ximena sorprende a su hijo Heriberto en una situación sospechosa con la tía Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le avisa al coronel Jiménez del nuevo cargamento que llega de Colombia, y le entrega la foto del Pombo para que sepa a quién deben arrestar, pero Leonor resulta herida en la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roxana le pide dinero a Guadalupe, pero él la toma por la fuerza y se aprovecha de ella. Mónica indaga sobre los contactos de su hermano. El coronel Jiménez le cuenta a Doris sobre su ascenso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez recibe un regalo especial. Chacorta llega a una colonia y hace un estudio para el expendio de la droga, habla con Aurelio y le dice que es una buena oportunidad de negocio en el país.

programme.desc: Aurelio tiene controlado todo el mercado del país con la venta en las colonias, y le pide a Irina que lo ponga en contacto con el presidente. Ella dice que con él no, pero sí con su primo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez da luz verde para ir por Casillas, y Mejía comienza un operativo para desmantelar toda la organización. Mónica le exige a Aurelio que active el negocio con Guadalupe.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía trata de interceptar las comunicaciones de los Casillas, pero decide renunciar porque se siente culpable por las muertes de personas inocentes. Aurelio ordena eliminar a Eugenia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto cae en las provocaciones de Matilde. Chacorta le dispara a Eugenia, pero hiere a Linares. Mejía se enfrenta a tiros con él y es Chacorta quien resulta herido, aunque logra escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio jura que Mejía se las va a pagar. Doña Alba hace entrega de los documentos de un lote de terreno, con el fin de presionar para que reciban nuevamente a Rutila en la escuela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Villalobos secuestran a Ximena, mientras Aurelio y Mónica se reencuentran. Doris y Jiménez organizan una cena con altos funcionarios del Gobierno por el nombramiento de Benítez.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia escucha la conversación que tiene Ramiro con Irina y decide arruinarlo. Juan Villalobos le dice a Ximena que están enterados de los amoríos de Heriberto y Matilde. Leonor activa su plan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo visita a Aurelio para contarle que lo quieren sacar del negocio y le pide que le dé una ruta; además, lo ayudará para rescatar a Ximena. Mejía usa una estrategia que incómoda a Jiménez.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia amenaza a Ramiro con contar todo durante la reunión, pero él le advierte que, si lo hace, uno de sus socios se encargará de acabar con ella. Guadalupe atenta contra Sabino.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente le pide a Mejía una lista de funcionarios sospechosos involucrados con el narcotráfico. Marco se entera de que Aurelio se infiltró en la policía y don Cleto mandó a matar a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde le reprocha a Chacorta el haber tenido un hijo con Aída. Sonia se va a confesar y le pide al sacerdote una cita con el cardenal para confesarle algo muy grave, y le da una libreta negra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y Tijeras se apoderan de la organización de Oscar Cadena, lo dejan herido y deciden entregarlo a las autoridades. Aurelio encuentra muertos a los Villalobos, por lo que le reclama a su suegro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia se reúne con el cardenal para enseñarle la libreta que compromete a Ramiro con el narcotráfico, y recibe una amenaza de su esposo. Leonor y Marco Mejía pasan la noche juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Eugenia se molesta con el cambio en el periódico. Mejía convence a Jiménez de no estar dispuesto a trabajar más con Leonor, y ella entra al estudio de grabación haciéndose pasar por fan de Alejo.

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV

programme.title: Hunting With HECS
programme.desc: This week we join legendary elk guide Ralph Ramos, who's in pursuit of screaming New Mexico Bulls with a variety of hunters.

programme.sub-title: Western Adventure for Big Finisher Walleyes

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: Kip heads out with his Hoyt bow on a west Texas spot and stalk elk and mule deer hunt with his friend, retired Navy Seal, Terry Houin.

programme.title: Live The Wild Life
programme.desc: Join the Live the Wild Life crew and friends as they explore the Salmon River.

programme.title: Midwest Outdoors
programme.desc: Morgan McMahon gets her first muzzleloader deer; Coach Jeff Quinn is after Steelhead on the St. Joe River; and we're in Wisconsin hunting turkeys with pneumatic shotguns!

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: Traveling to the Adirondack Mountains and caught up with George & Laurie Keith, who were chasing marten, otter, beaver and fisher. In two days, we probably checked over 100 traps in some of the most beautiful country in the US. Ride along with us.
programme.sub-title: George and Laurie catching Marten, Otter, Beaver and Fisher

programme.title: Whitetail Frenzy

programme.title: Weird Hunts

programme.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within

programme.title: The Bearded Buck

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Garrett G. Fagan addresses the importance of studying battles and surveys the changing scholarly approach to the subject; he concludes by looking at different definitions of warfare, particularly the operational and social-constructivist models.
programme.sub-title: Why Study Battles? What Is War?

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Three types of evidence shed light on the origins of warfare; human remains bearing evidence of trauma; artifacts that function primarily as weapons; fortifications or depictions of warriors painted on cave walls; their interpretations are tricky.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Written records first become available in the historical era; evidence reconstructs the conventions and conditions of warfare among the first cities in Sumer circa the 30th century B.C.; exploring the nature of Sumerian armies and battle tactics.
programme.sub-title: Sumer, Akkad, and Early Mesopotamian Warfare

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Evidence of warfare in ancient Egypt is ambiguous, but it is much more plentiful in later periods; the pharaoh's role is increasingly that of a war leader; Egyptian warfare is transformed by the introduction of the chariot.
programme.sub-title: Egyptian Warfare From the Old to New Kingdoms

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In the New Kingdom of Egypt, one gets the first fully recorded battle in history, the Battle of Megiddo; covering the later Battle of Kadesh, which is attested in both Egyptian and Hittite accounts.
programme.sub-title: The Battles of Megiddo and Kadesh

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Traveling back to the 14th century B.C. in Egypt; how the Malkata Palace represents a microcosm of Egypt; architectural details reveal insights about religious rituals how pharaohs attempt to assert their domination over others.
programme.sub-title: Malkata Palace: Pharaoh, Foreigners, and Gods

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Akhenaten shifts Egypt's capital to Amarna; how his worship of the sun disk defines an era built on temple crops, sacrifices and obedience to the pharaoh; how relocating his seat of power helps Akhenaten wrestle authority away from religious leaders.
programme.sub-title: Amarna: Palace of the First Sun King

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Studying Bronze Age Crete; the myth of Daedalus and his labyrinth symbolizes Crete's location at the intersection of multiple cultures; discovering the Phaistos Palace, the site of extravagant religious rituals and entertainment spectacles.
programme.sub-title: Phaistos: Palaces Between Asia and Europe

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the Palace of Nestor, a complex centered around the throne room; the ancient styles the Mycenaeans develop to bring these elaborate structures to life; what the arrangement of rooms reveals about how royals live and maintain control.
programme.sub-title: Palace of Nestor at Pylos and Bronze Age Greece

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.
programme.sub-title: A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruits Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: My Little Eye
programme.desc: As part of an Internet reality show, five people sign up to spend six months in a mansion while cameras film constantly. If each person stays the entire length of the show, everyone walks away with $1 million -- a premise that seems too good to be true. Strange things start happening, like the arrival of mysterious, disturbing packages, filled with items like guns and morbid letters. After an unexpected death, the participants start to question the true reality of this experiment.

programme.title: Missing Link
programme.desc: Upon returning to his camp from a nearby watering hole, a half-simian/half-human herbivore (Michael Gambon) -- the titular "missing link" between ape and man -- discovers his entire clan, friends and family have been killed by Stone Age humans. Thus begins a long search for others of his kind. As he traverses the African continent avoiding humans and looking for clues about his own species, he also befriends animals and learns about the world in which he is the last of his kind.

programme.title: Rage of the Yeti
programme.desc: Two adventurers (David Chokachi, Matthew Kevin Anderson) embark on a mission to rescue trapped researchers from vicious snow-beasts.

programme.title: Ghost Dad
programme.desc: Elliot Hopper (Bill Cosby) is a widowed single dad who is utterly fixated on his family's financial well-being. He spends all his time working to secure a crucial business deal that would put his accounts in the black. However, this leaves his three children pining for his attention. After a fatal car accident, Hopper -- now a ghost -- must clinch the deal from the afterlife to secure his children's futures. Along the way, he discovers all the bonding he'd been missing when he was alive.

programme.title: Radioland Murders
programme.desc: The secretary at radio station WBN, Penny Henderson (Mary Stuart Masterson) is frantically trying to keep things in order as a broadcast goes on the air. Chaos breaks loose, however, when a series of murders occurs in the building, accompanied by an enigmatic voice over the airwaves. Penny's writer husband, Roger (Brian Benben), tries to deduce who the killer is, but he also happens to be the prime suspect. As he evades the law, Roger gets closer to uncovering the identity of the murderer.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Shaun is a 30-something loser with a dull, easy existence. When he's not working at the electronics store, he lives with his slovenly best friend, Ed, in a small flat on the outskirts of London. The only unpredictable element in his life is his girlfriend, Liz, who wishes desperately for Shaun to grow up and be a man. When the town is inexplicably overrun with zombies, Shaun must rise to the occasion and protect both Liz and his mother.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Lily is a typical 150-year-old lovelorn vampire who's looking for the man of her nightmares -- until she lays her eyes on Herman, a 7-foot-tall green experiment with a heart of gold. It's love at first shock as these two ghouls fall fangs over feet for each other in a Transylvanian romance. Unfortunately, it's not all smooth sailing in the cemetery as Lily's father has other plans for his beloved daughter's future, and they don't involve her new bumbling beau.

programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: A boy (Scott Sealey) upset by his parents' divorce must also tell the sheriff his father (Kerwin Mathews) is a werewolf.

programme.title: Metalstorm: The Destruction of Jared-Syn
programme.desc: A space ranger (Jeffrey Byron) and his guide (Tim Thomerson) fight a wizard (Mike Preston) who rules with a giant crystal.

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: After decades of living on the run, murder suspect Frank O'Neal (Billy Burke) returns to Los Angeles hoping to put his derailed existence back on track. O'Neal reconnects with an old flame, Karen Mellor (Sherry Stringfield), and finds gainful employment as a driver for an armored truck service. But, as he falls under the influence of a maniacal televangelist (Gregory Itzin), the unsavory impulses behind O'Neal's return begin to surface, threatening to destroy him.

programme.desc: The Rev. Dave Hill defends a group of Christian home-schooling families after they receive an impromptu inspection from a progressive, local government official who doesn't like what she finds. Taken aback by her interference, Dave travels to Washington, D.C., to testify in a landmark congressional hearing that will determine the future of religious freedom in our country for years to come.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Dirt track racer Sean Weathers (Andrew Cheney) was at the top of his game with an unstoppable career. When a rivalry with another racer turns personal, the ego that propelled him to success causes a tragedy, sending his life into a tailspin. Jack Reed (Gary Graham) had prospered as a businessman but failed as a family man. In a sudden turn of events, his chances for reconciliation are ripped from his grasp. Sean and Jack's lives collide, and an unexpected bond forms between them.

programme.title: Indivisible
programme.desc: Fresh out of the seminary and basic training, Army chaplain Darren Turner receives orders to deploy to Iraq, leaving his wife behind to care for their three young children. The harsh realities of war soon take their toll on Turner and his battalion, making it hard to stay connected to his beloved family. When Darren finally comes home, the Turners must decide if they're willing to face one more battle -- the fight to save their marriage.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel (Albert Dekker) invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Ygor (Bela Lugosi) rescues the monster (Lon Chaney) from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son (Cedric Hardwicke).

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: House of Horrors
programme.desc: An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

programme.desc: A frustrated suburban housewife and her best friend hatch an illegal coupon-club scheme that scams millions from corporations and delivers deals to legions of fellow coupon clippers. Hot on their trail is an unlikely duo -- a hapless loss-prevention officer and a determined U.S. postal inspector -- both looking to end their criminal enterprise.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

programme.title: Hustlers
programme.desc: Working as a stripper to make ends meet, Destiny's life changes forever when she becomes friends with Ramona -- the club's top money earner. The FBI agent is curious, but unimpressed until Fenton reveals that the killer is his younger brother Adam. This is a film about faith, family and the end of innocence.

programme.desc: Opening statement was graphic and detailed on how Jennifer Fulford was kidnapped and later murdered. programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: Jennifer Fulford's boss testified for prosecutors. She was a nanny for this real estate investor's two children. programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: A missing person's case was how the detective on the stand told jurors about Jennifer Fulford's disappearance. She went missing from the home where she was working as a caretaker of two kids only to be found dead three days later in a wooded ditch just miles from the home. By the time Scott Nelson forced his way into the home where Fulford was working as a nanny, he was a drifter in Winter Park, Florida. He was homeless currently on federal probation for armed robbery.

programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: Prosecutors went deep into the security system of the home where he was alleged to have kidnapped Jennifer Fulford, a nanny in the home. The State alleged the defendant was a homeless guy loitering the neighborhood when he targeted Fulford in order to rob and kill her. programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: Follow the money was the theme in the police's investigation into Jennifer Fulford's death. On the stand was a bank representative who confirmed based on surveillance footage that Scott Nelson was the one who forced $400 of total withdrawals from Fulford's bank account. Prosecutors then brought in digital records of the victim's cell phone. They wanted to show jurors her movement when she was kidnapped and later found dead.

programme.title: Taboo Photos Murder Trial
programme.desc: Jurors were presented text messages of Jade Janks in the hours leading up to Tom Merriman's death. Prosecutors were using these texts as circumstantial evidence proving that she plotted the murder of her stepdad. These incriminating text messages dominated the courtroom Elmo. The State was using her communication with people she tried to hire as Hitman to take out her ailing stepfather.

programme.title: Taboo Photos Murder Trial
programme.desc: What began as inquiries in Facebook messages led to incriminating texts. The state alleged that Jade Janks reached out to a so-called fixer to help kill her stepdad, Tom Merriman, and make it look like he died of an overdose. Finally, the state of California rested their case against her after stipulating to the jury that both the prosecution and defense teams tried to locate Jade Janks fixer in this murder plot.

programme.title: Taboo Photos Murder Trial
programme.desc: The first witness for Jade Janks defense was a medical toxicologist. Emergency room physician Dr. Charles O'Connell reviewed both the autopsy and toxicology reports of Tom Merriman. Here's where the jury learned more about his poor health and the different kinds of medications he was on at the time he died. As a medical toxicologist Dr. Connell explained to the jury on why Merriman shouldn't have been on the drugs.

programme.title: Taboo Photos Murder Trial
programme.desc: Medical toxicologist, Dr. Charles O'Connell gave a summary on Tom Merriman's poor health in the lead up to his death. It included an enlarged liver, congestive heart failure and underlying lung problems. This was in conjuction to his alleged alcohol and prescription drug abuse. Next up, Jade Janks took the stand in her own murder trial. It was her attempt to clear herself from the first-degree murder in the death of her stepfather.

programme.title: Taboo Photos Murder Trial
programme.desc: Jurors learned more about Jade Janks relationship with Tom Merriman in the years leading up to his death. Janks told jurors that he had no issues with her stepdad and the two had a close relationship. She would often call him Dad. Both defendant and victim in this case was on a number of different prescription medication. programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: While on the stand in his own murder trial, the State portrayed Ali Abulaban as a controlling, abusive husband whose jealousy led him to plot and carry out the murders of his wife, Ana, and her friend, Rayburn Barron. programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: The forensic pathologist who conducted the autopsy of Jennifer Fulford testified. Jurors learned the brutal fashion she lost her life by multiple stab wounds and suffocation. Multiple fatal stab wounds and suffocation by duct tape was the way Jennifer Fulford lost her life. programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: The State was completing the bus route of the Scott Nelson just hours after he allegedly kidnapped Jennifer Fulford. But just days later Nelson was arrested in Jacksonville, Florida--140 miles away.

programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial

programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
programme.desc: A Walmart employee took the stand. Prosecutors wanted to confirm the items Scott Nelson brought before he allegedly killed Jennifer Fulford. programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial

programme.desc: Una enfermera atropella por accidente a un niño y decide estar al pendiente de su recuperación, luego se vuelven amigos.

programme.title: Trampas de amor
programme.desc: El amor, la infidelidad y el deseo son los protagonistas de tres historias llenas de enredos y romance.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Los Jinetes de la Bruja
programme.desc: Una bruja y sus jinetes ayudan a los pobres y protegen sus tierras de unos ambiciosos hombres que quieren conseguirlas.

programme.title: El caballo del diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre malvado se viste de negro y monta su caballo del mismo color, para realizar cosas abominables e ilegales.

programme.title: Palenque
programme.desc: Un hombre obsesionado con un hijo varón tiene una hija y la cría en la rudeza del campo, los caballos y los palenques.

programme.title: Magnicidio: Complot en Lomas Taurinas
programme.desc: En los más altos niveles del gobierno se planean los asesinatos y se hace a un lado toda la lucha por mejorar los destinos de un país.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: The Last Rebel
programme.desc: Missouri, 1865, dos confederados (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) salvan la vida de un hombre (Woody Strode) y provocan problemas.

programme.title: La doncella de piedra
programme.desc: Una joven vuelve a Venezuela tras estudiar en Estados Unidos y ayuda a una tribu que la cree la doncella de una leyenda.

programme.title: Me quiero casar
programme.desc: Una joven americana, de turista en México, se enamora de un joven mexicano, y a ambos le esperan muchas aventuras.

programme.title: Contrabandistas del Caribe
programme.desc: Un humanitario gánster rescata a una mujer que se lanzó del yate de un contrabandista que quería abusar de ella.

programme.title: El gran perro muerto
programme.desc: Arrollan a un perro común y el incidente provoca un enorme lío en un pueblo porque nadie quiere levantar sus restos y se produce un caos. El asunto llega a la capital del estado como cuestión federal, y el ejercito interviene para que vuelva la paz.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: El Yaqui
programme.desc: Abandonan a un niño yaqui en un pueblo donde sus mayores fueron engañados para ser reclutados al ejército federal. Una prostituta se retira de su oficio para rescatar al menor y cuidarlo.

programme.title: El hijo de Gabino Barrera
programme.desc: El hijo de Gabino Barrera quiere vengar la muerte de su padre y tiene el apoyo de los campesinos, pero se enamora de la hija del presunto asesino, quien al confesar, desata un enfrentamiento.

programme.title: La hermanita dinamita
programme.desc: Una enfermera atropella por accidente a un niño y decide estar al pendiente de su recuperación, luego se vuelven amigos.

programme.title: La Revancha: Palenque II
programme.desc: Una poderosa hacendada se enfrenta a un grupo de pistoleros que se quieren adueñar de su palenque y de sus tierras.

programme.title: El puente
programme.desc: Un mexicano ilegal colabora con un cubano exiliado en los Estados Unidos a fin de ayudar a sus hermanos ilegales.

programme.title: El Silla de Ruedas
programme.desc: Un padre de familia cría a sus hijos para que sean unos matones, al quedar paralítico es apodado "El Silla de Ruedas".

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Un rayo de luz
programme.desc: Un hombre de la nobleza adopta a una chica que cambiará alegremente la vida de todos en un castillo.

programme.title: Como perros y gatos
programme.desc: Dos compadres quieren casar entre sí a sus hijos, un ingeniero y una estudiante de psicología, pero ellos se detestan.

programme.title: Nido de tiburones
programme.desc: Tres buscadores de tesoros enfrentan asesinato y traición, además de aguas infestadas de tiburones en la costa africana.
